config.prompt: Turn the inspected wiki state for Review pending book updates into a concrete revision plan. Specify which pages to create or update under wiki/entities/, wiki/concepts/, wiki/synthesis/, wiki/sources/, wiki/queries/, plus the required changes to wiki/index.md and wiki/log.md. Prefer cumulative revisions over one-off chat summaries. Favor stable domain pages and synthesis pages over token-derived or low-signal pages. Merge or delete noisy pages instead of preserving weak ontology.

config.request_text: Apply the approved wiki revision plan for Review pending book updates. Edit the wiki markdown directly, keep raw/ immutable, update cross-links, and make sure wiki/index.md and wiki/log.md reflect the changes. Prefer high-signal source summaries, stable entity/concept naming, and synthesis-first organization over token extraction.

Review the wiki revisions for Review pending book updates. Check link integrity, missing backreferences, unsupported claims, stale wording, whether wiki/index.md and wiki/log.md were updated consistently, and whether the resulting ontology is clean rather than token-derived.

config.prompt: Summarize the wiki ingest result for Review pending book updates. Explain what pages changed, what claims were strengthened or challenged, what remains uncertain, and which next sources or follow-up questions would most improve the wiki.
